mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS name, t.name AS type, u.code AS code, p.name AS parentName, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.name, c.name, t.name, p.name
SELECT * FROM units WHERE NOT type_id = 1

SELECT u.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS name, t.name AS type, u.code AS code, p.name AS parentName, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE NOT u.type_id = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.name, c.name, t.name, p.name ORDER BY u.id
SELECT parent.* FROM units child LEFT JOIN units parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS name, t.name AS type, u.code AS code, p.name AS parentName, COUNT(e.id) AS employeeCount FROM units u LEFT JOIN companies c ON u.company_id = c.id LEFT JOIN unit_types t ON u.type_id = t.id LEFT JOIN units p ON u.parent_id = p.id LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.unit_id = u.id WHERE parent_id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.name, c.name, t.name, p.name ORDER BY u.id

SELECT e.id AS id, c.name AS companyName, u.name AS unitName, e.first_name AS firstName, e.last_name AS lastName, p.name AS position, e.email AS email, e.phone AS phone, e.dob AS dob FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE e.unit_id = #{id} GROUP BY e.id, c.name, u.name, p.name ORDER BY e.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO units (company_id, name, type_id, code, parent_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{typeId}, #{code}, #{parentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE units SET company_id = #{companyId}, name = #{name}, type_id = #{typeId}, code = #{code}, parent_id = #{parentId} WHERE id = #{id}
